strategy.note: basis: Fig. 6.1 'Flows for vermiculite, at mine and their representation in the ecoinvent database' [ZA], per 1 kg; allocation: The co-mined apatite/phosphate is explicitly neither a co-product nor a waste ('Since the apatite is dumped but afterwards used by other companies it is neither considered co-product nor waste'), so no allocation is applied and the phosphorus resource is booked in full on the vermiculite.. Review every derivation; unreviewed entries have reviewed_by = null.

gaps_reported_by_model: No dust emissions appear in Fig. 6.1 although the metadata says bauxite-mining dust is used as a proxy for them.
No recultivation input although the metadata says the module 'recultivation, limestone mine' is used as a proxy.
No transport within or out of the mine beyond the diesel for the machines.
No water use and no water emissions.
The metadata notes that no mining losses are taken into account as no data were available.
